French Municipal Police
----------
Political Section
--------
Report No. 4250/1
1020
22 8 41
Shanghai, August 19, 1941.

Subject: Arrest of the leading members of the mutual
Aid Association of Chinese employees of Foreign
Hotels in Shanghai in the course of an
unauthorized meeting (in violation of Consular
Ordinance No. 45 of May 3, 1927).

Reference: Labour Movement.

At 4.30 p.m. August 17, 1941, we proceeded to
No. 218 Route Prentice where an unauthorized meeting was
being held by leading members of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai (上海外
洋商旅館業華員互助會).

Acting on instructions received and with
the assistance of four agents from Poste Centrale, we
arrested the persons present, 18 in all. The attendance
included seven employees of Cathay Mansions, three of
Hamilton House, four of Metropole Hotel, three of Cathay
Hotel and Wang Yih San (汪逸三), a representative of the
Social Movement Direction Committee.

The meeting, which was convened by the
Committee, was held to mark the assumption of office by the
Committee members of the Association. It will be recalled
that this body was inaugurated on August 3 in the premises
of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce on North Honan Road.

The men are being detained pending an
investigation. Nothing of a nature detrimental to their
22 8 character is known to the Police.

On the person of Fu Kao Dah (傅高達), the
Chairman of the Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees
of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai, and Wang Yih San, member of

第 4250/1 号报告
1020
1941年8月22日
上海，1941年8月19日。

事由：在上海外商旅馆业华员互助会主要成员举行未经批准的集会期间将其逮捕（违反1927年5月3日第45号领事章程）。

参考：劳工运动。

1941年8月17日下午4时30分，我们前往普恩梯路（Route Prentice）218号，当时上海外商旅馆业华员互助会（上海外洋商旅館業華員互助會）的主要成员正在那里举行未经批准的集会。

根据收到的指示，并在中央捕房四名探员的协助下，我们逮捕了在场人员，共计18人。出席者包括国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）的七名雇员、汉密尔顿大厦（Hamilton House）的三名雇员、大都会饭店（Metropole Hotel）的四名雇员、国泰饭店（Cathay Hotel）的三名雇员，以及社会运动指导委员会代表汪逸三。

此次会议由该委员会召集，旨在庆祝协会委员就职。回想起来，该组织于8月3日在河南路北市商会会所成立。

这些人正被拘留以待调查。警方未掌握任何有损其品格性质的信息。

在上海外商旅馆业华员互助会主席傅高達和社

page_data.en:
ANNEX II - (a)

Letter from staff of Sassoon House addressed to
the Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees of
Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

--------

Dear Sirs,

After your Association had registered with
the Municipal government, you have been very active; you
have not only given proof of your courage in protecting
your members, but (you have created) a genuine union.
This merits our admiration. With the object of
strengthening the bonds of friendship and concentrating
our energy, we intend to join (your Association) so as
to be in a position to receive your advice when it is
needed. As your Association is at the head of society,
we think you will not refuse our request. Furthermore,
we are all colleagues of the firm of Sassoon. We
think you will welcome our request.

August 7, 1941.
page_data.zh:
附件 II - (a)

沙逊大厦职员致上海外商旅馆业华员互助会的信。

--------

敬启者：

贵会在市政府注册后，活动非常活跃；你们不仅在保护会员方面证明了勇气，而且（建立了）一个真正的工会。这值得我们要钦佩。为了加强友谊纽带并集中我们的力量，我们打算加入（贵会），以便在需要时能够接受你们的指导。鉴于贵会在社会上处于领导地位，我们认为你们不会拒绝我们的请求。此外，我们都是沙逊公司的同事。我们认为你们会欢迎我们的请求。

1941年8月7日。

Movement Direction Committee to the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

We have the honour to inform you that
we have received your petition informing us that the
ceremony of assumption of office by members of the
Executive Committee and the Supervisory Committee will
take place at 2 p.m. on August 17 and requesting us
to send a delegate to give directions at this ceremony.
We are detailing Hong Zong Kiang (to
whom we have handed) this letter to assist and to
give directions.

August 16.

Social Movement Direction Committee is located at
No. 527 Range Road, Telephone No. 44542)

page_data.en:
ANNEX II - (d)

Articles of Association of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

Manifesto issued on the occasion of the
inauguration of the Mutual Aid Association of Chinese
Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai :-

Since the development of maritime
transportation and commerce, the number of Europeans
and Americans coming to do business in China has
increased day by day. As Shanghai is an important
commercial port, wherein merchants gather, the
business of the foreign hotels is becoming more and
more prosperous every day.

At present, the number of our comrades
has reached 10,000. Most of them have to work hard
and their hand and feet are calloused, while the
foreigners, taking advantage of their political and
economic superiority, are unreasonably oppressing them
and insulting us. Not only is our pay so small that
we are finding it difficult to clothe and feed ourselves
adequately, but we have no protection in our profession.
There is no pension for our (retirement) because of
old age or invalidation, nor allowance in case of
sickness or death.

Since the outbreak of hostilities in
Shanghai, the value of foreign money has increased
considerably while that of legal tender has dropped.
Besides suffering from the effects of the war, we
are now suffering from the high cost of living.
page_data.zh:
附件二 - (d)

上海外商旅馆华籍职工互助会章程。

上海外商旅馆华籍职工互助会成立宣言：

自海运交通与商业发展以来，来华经商的欧美人士日益增多。上海作为重要的通商口岸，商贾云集，外商旅馆的业务也日渐繁荣。

目前，我同仁人数已达一万之众。大多数人辛勤劳作，手足生茧，而外人仗恃其政治与经济上的优势，无理压迫并侮辱我们。不仅我们的薪金微薄，难以维持基本的衣食，而且我们在职业上毫无保障。因年老或残疾而（退休）者无养老金，患病或身故者亦无津贴。

page_data.en:
-2-

At the present time, all trades are
increasing, the salaries and allowances (of their
employees) so as to permit them to maintain their
livelihood; only the Chinese employees of (foreign)
hotels are being menaced with wage reduction and
dismissal. For the past dozens of years, we
have existed like slaves under the oppression
of foreigners. All this is due to our lack
of union.

We, the Chinese employees of (foreign)
hotels, have never had any organization to
strengthen our bonds of friendship, nor have we had an
opportunity to unite; for these reasons, we can be
dispersed like sand. All talk of mutual assistance
and collaboration was useless talk.

On this account, we have organized a
Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees of Foreign
Hotels in Shanghai. Through the efforts of our
zealous members during the past six months and the
assistance of a majority of our comrades, the
Association has been officially inaugurated. Henceforth,
it will seek, in conformity with the object for which it
was formed, to bring about a sincere and spiritual
union, mutual assistance and material collaboration among
our Chinese comrades in the employ of foreign hotels.

As it is all for the welfare of our members,
we hope that members will each do their best to assure the
smooth working (of the Association). The future of our
Association will depend upon these (efforts).
page_data.zh:
-2-

自上海战事爆发以来，外币币值大幅上涨，而法币币值下跌。我们除了遭受战争的影响外，现在还深受生活成本高昂之苦。

当前，各行各业都在增加（其员工的）薪水和津贴，以维持生计；唯独（外商）旅馆的华籍职工面临减薪和解雇的威胁。过去几十年来，我们在外人的压迫下如奴隶般生存。这一切都是由于我们缺乏团结所致。

我们（外商）旅馆的华籍职工，从未有过任何组织来加强彼此间的友谊纽带，也没有机会联合起来；因此，我们如一盘散沙。所有关于互助与合作的谈论都成了空话。

有鉴于此，我们组织了上海外商旅馆华籍职工互助会。经过热心会员过去六个月的努力以及大多数同仁的协助，本会已正式成立。此后，本会将依照成立宗旨，致力于在受雇于外商旅馆的华籍同仁之间，实现真诚的精神联合、互助及物质合作。

既然这一切都是为了会员的福利，我们希望每位会员各尽所能，确保（本会）工作顺利进行。本会的前途将取决于这些（努力）。

page_data.en:
ANNEX II - (d)

Articles of Association of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

Chapter I - General Principles

Article 1.- Our Association being formed
by Chinese employees of foreign hotels in this city (including
hotels, boarding houses, restaurants, bars, cafes, etc.
large and small, operated by foreigners) is called "Mutual
Aid Association of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in
Shanghai".

Article 2.- The object of the Association is
to strengthen the bonds of friendship, promote exchange of
knowledge, reform (bad) habits, practise mutual aid,
commend the spirit of collaboration and to forward the
welfare of members.

Article 3.- The office of the Association is
located for the time being at No. 218 Rue Pranties, French
Concession, Shanghai.

Chapter II. - Members

Article 4.- Any Chinese, irrespective of
sex or age, who works in a hotel, restaurant, boarding
house, bar or cafe operated by foreigner in this city may
become a member of the Association.

Article 5.- Any person who approves the
object of our Association and who desires to join may
become a member provided he satisfies the following
conditions : filling ipthe certificate of adherence; being
introduced by at least two members of the Association; are
approved of by the administrative Committee.
page_data.zh:
附件二 - (d)

上海外商旅馆华籍职工互助会章程。

第一章 - 总则

第一条 - 本会由本市外商经营的旅馆、寄宿舍、餐馆、酒吧、咖啡馆等大小场所的华籍职工组成，定名为“上海外商旅馆华籍职工互助会”。

第二条 - 本会的宗旨是加强友谊纽带，促进知识交流，革除（不良）习惯，实行互助，提倡合作精神，并增进会员福利。

第三条 - 本会办事处暂设于上海法租界蒲石路（Rue Pranties）218号。

第二章 - 会员

第四条 - 凡在本市外商经营的旅馆、餐馆、寄宿舍、酒吧或咖啡馆工作的华人，不分性别年龄，均可成为本会会员。

第五条 - 凡赞同本会宗旨并愿意加入者，在满足以下条件后可成为会员：填写入会申请书；由至少两名本会会员介绍；并经行政委员会批准。

a) 遵守本会章程及决议。
b) 在工作时间之外，实践本会决议中提到的有关革新和互助的义务，接受本会委派的任务和工作。
c) 定期缴纳会费，并按本会要求进行调查。
d) 为本会进行宣传，并尽可能介绍新会员，以巩固本会基础。
e) 按时参加本会会议。
f) 不妨碍他人的工作。
g) 不兼营任何非法事业。

Article 9.- Members of the Association will
enjoy the following privileges:-

a) To make propositions and to submit
projects for the reform of the Association.

b) To vote and to be voted for.

c) To make use of all the equipment of the
Association.

d) Every member who has retired because of old
age or weakness or who has lost his employment through
being invalidated may obtain payment of a monthly
allowance from the Special Welfare Committee provided

is payable only to those who have been members for

e) In the event of the death of a member, his
family may solicit an allowance from the Special
Welfare Committee, in conformity with the regulations
drawn up by the Committee.

Article 10.- Any member who violates any of the
stipulations mentioned above in Article 8 will be given a

expelled according to the nature of the offence.

Article 11.- Any member who changes his profession
or who applies for withdrawal from the Association, must
state his reasons in writing . He can withdraw from the
Association only with the permission of the Administrative
Committee. The amounts he has contributed will not be
refunded to him.

Article 12.- If a member is involved in one of the
following cases, the Administrative Committee will order
his expulsion and will warn him of the step; furthermore,
he must make a report to the general meeting of members:-

a) if he is in arrears for three months or
more with the payment of his subscriptions ( except
in the case of honorary members or the unemployed).

b) if he leaves his employment in a foreign
concern without giving notice to the Association.

第九条 - 本会会员享有以下权利：

a) 提出建议并提交改革本会的方案。

b) 拥有选举权和被选举权。

c) 使用本会的所有设备。

d) 凡因年老体弱而退休，或因残疾而失业的会员，经特别福利委员会批准，可领取月度津贴，但其申请须附有至少两名本会会员签署的证明，并经行政委员会调查后批准。然而，此津贴仅发给入会至少六个月的会员。

e) 会员身故后，其家属可根据特别福利委员会制定的规章，向该委员会申请津贴。

第十条 - 任何违反上述第八条规定的会员，将由行政委员会给予书面警告，或根据违规性质予以开除。

第十一条 - 任何改变职业或申请退出本会的会员，必须以书面形式陈述理由。只有经行政委员会许可，方可退出本会。其所缴纳的款项不予退还。

第十二条 - 若会员涉及以下情况之一，行政委员会将命令将其开除，并告知此举；此外，还须向会员大会报告：

a) 拖欠会费三个月或以上者（荣誉会员或失业者除外）。

b) 在未通知本会的情况下，离开外商机构的工作岗位者。

Association, to carry out or to conclude contracts

the Association.
c) To elaborate the bye-laws and the
regulations of the internal service of the
Administrative Committee, the Special Welfare

ANNEX II - (f)

Letter sent by one Tsu Zeu Ou to Mr. Fu, member
of the Executive Committee of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai

Our Association was inaugurated two weeks
ago. To-day the members of the Executive Committee and
the Supervisory Committee will assume office. I am
very happy.

I have temporarily preserved the list of
members of our Association from the day that it was set
up to the time of its inauguration. As men of
talent have been secured and we have before us capable
men and as I have concluded my mission, I have to
request you to designate some person to take possession
of the list of members in order to develop the work
of the Association.

August 17, 1941.

ANNEX II - (E)

Letter from a lift-man of Cathay Mansions on
Rue Bourgeat addressed to members of the Executive Committee
and the Supervisory Committee of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

On the introduction of Mr. Zeng, I have been
working during the past six months as substitute lift-man
at the Cathay Mansions. The work is heavy and the pay
is the minimum. I have borne with this only in the hope
of better days to come.

On August 9, the proprietor of the hotel
desired to engage 3 lift-men. I was very happy upon
learning of this. However, on the following day, I
was dismissed. Astonished, I went to the manager's
office for information and I learned that he had
no intention to dismiss me. I then went to see the
Sub-manager who promised to engage me, but the foreman
Zi Kia Fong and Lou King Ling of the lift service induced
the sub-manager to dismiss me. However, they are also
members of your association and your object is to develop
the welfare and the spirit of mutual aid. They not only
failed to come to my assistance but, using their position
they oppressed us. All this is contrary to the principal
object of your Association.

For some time now, I have tried to join
your Association on the introduction of member Tsong Cu
but Mr. Ou Ze Yong, Chairman of the Administrative
Committee of your Association, informed Mr. Zeng that
in view of the fact that I was substitute, it was
not necessary for me to join the Association.
page_data.zh:
附件二 - (E)

布尔热路 (Rue Bourgeat) 国泰公寓 (Cathay Mansions) 一名电梯工致上海外洋商旅业华员互助会执行委员会和监事会成员的信件。

经曾先生介绍，过去六个月我在国泰公寓担任替补电梯工。工作繁重，工资最低。我忍受这一切，只是希望将来情况好转。

8月9日，酒店业主希望雇佣3名电梯工。得知此事我非常高兴。然而，第二天我被解雇了。我感到惊讶，前往经理办公室询问情况，得知他无意解雇我。随后我去见副经理，他承诺雇佣我，但电梯服务部的领班 Zi Kia Fong 和 Lou King Ling 唆使副经理解雇我。然而，他们也是贵会会员，而贵会的宗旨是增进福利和互助精神。他们不仅没有协助我，反而利用职位压迫我们。所有这些都违背了贵会的主要宗旨。

一段时间以来，我曾试图经会员宗祖 (Tsong Cu) 介绍加入贵会，但贵会行政委员会主席欧泽永 (Ou Ze Yong) 先生告知曾先生，鉴于我是替补人员，没有必要加入本会。

page_data.en:
-2-

However, according to the terms of Article 2 of your
regulations, I possess the qualifications to become
a member of your Association. I have lost my
present employment and it is difficult to find work
elsewhere. Consequently, I am relating to you the
circumstances of my dismissal and the oppression
I have had to endure.

I request your assistance.

(signed) Vong Jen Pao,
No. 4 Yong En Lee,
Rue Wagner.

August 16, 1941.
page_data.zh:
-2-

然而，根据贵会章程第二条的规定，我具备成为贵会会员的资格。我失去了目前的工作，在其他地方找工作也很困难。因此，我向你们陈述我被解雇的情况以及我所遭受的压迫。

我请求你们的援助。

（签名）翁仁宝 (Vong Jen Pao)，
汪恩里4号，
瓦格纳路 (Rue Wagner)。

1941年8月16日。

French Municipal Police
------------
Political Section
--------
Report No. 4250/1

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
BR. REGISTRY
Shanghai, August 18, 1941.

Subject: Arrest of the leading members of the Mutual
Aid Association of Chinese Employees of Foreign
Hotels in Shanghai in the course of an
unauthorized meeting (in violation of Consular
Ordinance No. 45 of May 3, 1927).

Reference: Labour Movement.

At 4.30 p.m. August 17, 1941, we proceeded to
No. 218 Route Prentice where an unauthorized meeting was
being held by leading members of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai (上海外
洋商旅業華員互助會).

Acting on instructions received and with
the assistance of four agents from Poste Centrale, we
arrested the persons present, 18 in all. The attendance
included seven employees of Cathay Mansions, three of
Hamilton House, four of Metropole Hotel, three of Cathay
Hotel and Wang Yih San (汪逸三), a representative of the
Social Movement Direction Committee.

The meeting, which was convened by the
Committee, was held to mark the assumption of office by the
Committee members of the Association. It will be recalled
that this body was inaugurated on August 3 in the premises
of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce on North Honan Road.

The men are being detained pending an
investigation. Nothing of a nature detrimental to their
character is known to the Police.

On the person of Fu Kao Dah (傅高達), the
Chairman of the Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees
of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai, and Wang Yih San, member of

报告第 4250/1 号

上海公共租界工部局警务处
BR. 登记处
上海，1941年8月18日。

主题：上海外洋商旅业华员互助会主要成员在未经批准的集会期间被捕（违反1927年5月3日第45号领事法令）。

参考：劳工运动。

1941年8月17日下午4时30分，我们前往普伦蒂斯路 (Route Prentice) 218号，上海外洋商旅业华员互助会的主要成员正在那里举行未经批准的集会。

根据收到的指示，并在中央捕房四名探员的协助下，我们逮捕了在场人员，共18人。出席者包括国泰公寓的七名员工、汉密尔顿大厦 (Hamilton House) 的三名员工、大都会饭店 (Metropole Hotel) 的四名员工、国泰饭店 (Cathay Hotel) 的三名员工，以及社会运动指导委员会代表汪逸三。

此次会议由委员会召集，旨在庆祝协会委员会成员就职。回顾一下，该组织于8月3日在河南北路上海总商会 premises 内正式成立。

这些人正在被拘留以待调查。警方未发现任何有损其品格的行为。

在上海外洋商旅业华员互助会主席傅高达 (Fu Kao Dah) 和社会运动指导委员会成员汪逸三身上，发现

page_data.en:
ANNEX II - (a)

Letter from staff of Sassoon House addressed to
the Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees of
Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

--------

Dear Sirs,

After your Association had registered with
the Municipal government, you have been very active; you
have not only given proof of your courage in protecting
your members, but (you have created) a genuine union.
This merits our admiration. With the object of
strengthening the bonds of friendship and concentrating
our energy, we intend to join (your Association) so as
to be in a position to receive your advice when it is
needed. As your Association is at the head of society,
we think you will not refuse our request. Furthermore,
we are all colleagues of the firm of Sassoon. We
think you will welcome our request.

August 7, 1941.

敬启者，

贵会在市政府注册后，一直非常活跃；你们不仅在保护会员方面证明了勇气，而且（建立了）一个真正的工会。这值得我们要钦佩。为了加强友谊纽带并集中我们的力量，我们打算加入（贵会），以便在需要时能够接受你们的建议。鉴于贵会在社会中处于领先地位，我们认为你们不会拒绝我们的请求。此外，我们都是沙逊洋行的同事。我们认为你们会欢迎我们的请求。

ANNEX II - (d)

Articles of Association of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

Manifesto issued on the occasion of the
inauguration of the Mutual Aid Association of Chinese
Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai :-

Since the development of maritime
transportation and commerce, the number of Europeans
and Americans coming to do business in China has
increased day by day. As Shanghai is an important
commercial port, wherein merchants gather, the
business of the foreign hotels are becoming more and
more prosperous every day.

At present, the number of our comrades
has reached 10,000. Most of them have to work hard
and their hand and feet are calloused, while the
foreigners, taking advantage of their political and
economic superiority, are unreasonably oppressing them
and insulting us. Not only is our pay so small that
we are finding it difficult to clothe and feed ourselves
adequately, but we have no protection in our profession.
There is no pension for our (retirement) because of
old age or invalidation, nor allowance in case of
sickness or death.

Since the outbreak of hostilities in
Shanghai, the value of foreign money has increased
considerably while that of legal tender has dropped.
Besides suffering from the effects of the war, we
are now suffering from the high cost of living.
page_data.zh:
附件二 - (d)

上海外商旅馆华员互助会章程。

上海外商旅馆华员互助会成立宣言：-

自海运交通与商业发展以来，来华经商之欧美人士日益增多。上海作为重要通商口岸，商贾云集，外商旅馆之业务亦日渐繁荣。

目前，我同仁人数已达一万之众。大多数人辛勤劳作，手足生茧，而外人凭借其在政治与经济上的优势，无理压迫并侮辱我等。不仅薪资微薄，难以维持衣食，且职业毫无保障。年老或残疾时无养老金，患病或身故时亦无津贴。

自上海战事爆发以来，外币价值大幅上涨，而法币价值下跌。除遭受战争影响外，我等如今又深受生活成本高昂之苦。

page_data.en:
-2-

At the present time, all trades are
increasing, the salaries and allowances (of their
employees) so as to permit them to maintain their
livelihood; only the Chinese employees of (foreign)
hotels are being menaced with wage reduction and
dismissal. For the past dozens of years, we
have existed like slaves under the oppression
of foreigners. All this is due to our lack
of union.

We, the Chinese employees of (foreign)
hotels, have never had any organization to
strengthen our bonds of friendship, nor have we had an
opportunity to unite; for these reasons, we can be
dispersed like sand. All talk of mutual assistance
and collaboration was useless talk.

On this account, we have organized a
Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees of Foreign
Hotels in Shanghai. Through the efforts of our
zealous members during the past six months and the
assistance of a majority of our comrades, the
Association has been officially inaugurated. Henceforth,
it will seek, in conformity with the object for which it
was formed, to bring about a sincere and spiritual
union, mutual assistance and material collaboration among
our Chinese comrades in the employ of foreign hotels.

As it is all for the welfare of our members,
we hope that members will each do their best to assure the
smooth working (of the Association). The future of our
Association will depend upon these (efforts).
page_data.zh:
-2-

当下，各行各业均在增加员工薪资与津贴，以维持其生计；唯独外商旅馆之华籍雇员面临减薪与解雇之威胁。过去数十年来，我们在外人的压迫下如奴隶般生存。这一切皆因我们缺乏团结。

我等外商旅馆华籍雇员，从未有任何组织来加强彼此友谊，亦无联合之机会；因此，我们如散沙一般。所有关于互助与合作的言论皆为空谈。

有鉴于此，我们组织了上海外商旅馆华员互助会。经过热心会员过去六个月的努力以及大多数同仁的协助，本会已正式成立。此后，本会将依照成立宗旨，致力于在受雇于外商旅馆的华籍同仁之间实现真诚的精神联合、互助及物质合作。

既然这一切皆为了会员的福祉，我们希望每位会员各尽所能，确保本会顺利运作。本会之前途将取决于这些（努力）。

page_data.en:
ANNEX II - (a)

Articles of Association of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

Chapter I - General Principles

Article 1.- Our Association being formed
by Chinese employees of foreign hotels in this city (including
hotels, boarding houses, restaurants, bars, cafes, etc.
large and small, operated by foreigners) is called "Mutual
Aid Association of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in
Shanghai".

Article 2.- The object of the Association is
to strengthen the bonds of friendship, promote exchange of
knowledge, reform (bad) habits, practise mutual aid,
commend the spirit of collaboration and to forward the
welfare of members.

Article 3.- The office of the Association is
located for the time being at No. 218 Rue Prentice, French
Concession, Shanghai.

Chapter II - Members

Article 4.- Any Chinese, irrespective of
sex or age, who works in a hotel, restaurant, boarding
house, bar or cafe operated by foreigner in this city may
become a member of the Association.

Article 5.- Any person who approves the
object of our Association and who desires to join may
become a member provided he satisfies the following
conditions : filling in the certificate of adherence; being
introduced by at least two members of the Association; are
approved of by the administrative Committee.
page_data.zh:
附件二 - (a)

上海外商旅馆华员互助会章程。

第一章 - 总则

第一条.- 本会由本市外商经营的旅馆、寄宿舍、餐馆、酒吧、咖啡馆等（无论大小）之华籍雇员组成，定名为“上海外商旅馆华员互助会”。

第二条.- 本会宗旨为加强友谊纽带，促进知识交流，革除（不良）习惯，实行互助，提倡合作精神，并增进会员福利。

第三条.- 本会办事处暂设于上海法租界普恩济思路218号。

第二章 - 会员

第四条.- 凡在本市外商经营的旅馆、餐馆、寄宿舍、酒吧或咖啡馆工作的华人，不分性别年龄，均可成为本会会员。

第五条.- 凡赞同本会宗旨并愿意加入者，在满足以下条件后可成为会员：填写入会证书；由至少两名本会会员介绍；经行政委员会批准。

must, at the time of admission, pay the admission dues and

第六条.- 每位会员在入会时，必须缴纳入会费，并填写一份包含其最近住址的个人履历表。所有地址变更必须在规定时间内向本会报告。此手续旨在必要时方便召开会议。

第七条.- 已退会并希望重新加入本会的会员，必须如同新会员一样履行入会手续。

第八条.- 本会会员须承担以下义务：-
a) 遵守本会细则及决议。
b) 在工作时间之外，实践本会决议中提及的关于革新与互助的义务，接受本会委派的任务和工作。
c) 定期缴纳会费，并按本会要求进行调查。
d) 为本会进行宣传，并尽可能多地介绍新会员，以巩固本会基础。
e) 按规定时间参加本会会议。
f) 不妨碍他人的工作。
g) 不同时从事任何非法活动。
h) 尽力协助任何去世、患病或处于困境的会员；如有必要，一

page_data.en:
-3-

subscription may be opened for his relief.

Article 9.- Members of the Association will
enjoy the following privileges:-
a) To make propositions and to submit
projects for the reform of the Association.
b) To vote and to be voted for.
c) To make use of all the equipment of the
Association.
d) Every member who has retired because of old
age or weakness or who has lost his employment through
being invalidated may obtain payment of a monthly
allowance from the Special Welfare Committee provided
that his request is accompanied by an attestation
signed by at least two members of the Association
and has been approved by the Administrative Committee
after an investigation. However, this allowance
is payable only to those who have been members for
at least six months.
e) In the event of the death of a member, his
family may solicit an allowance from the Special
Welfare Committee, in conformity with the regulations
drawn up by the Committee.

Article 10.- Any member who violates any of the
stipulations mentioned above in Article 8 will be given a
written warning by the Administrative Committee or he may be
expelled according to the nature of the offence.

Article 11.- Any member who changes his profession
or who applies for withdrawal from the Association, must
state his reasons in writing . He can withdraw from the
Association only with the permission of the Administrative
Committee. The amounts he has contributed will not be
refunded to him.

Article 12.- If a member is involved in one of the
following cases, the Administrative Committee will order
his expulsion and will warn him of the step; furthermore,
he must make a report to the general meeting of members:-
a) if he is in arrears for three months or
more with the payment of his subscriptions ( except
in the case of honorary members or the unemployed).
b) if he leaves his employment in a foreign
concern without giving notice to the Association.
page_data.zh:

可发起募捐以资救济。

第九条.- 本会会员享有以下特权：-
a) 提出建议并提交本会改革方案。
b) 拥有选举权和被选举权。
c) 使用本会所有设备。
d) 凡因年老体弱而退休，或因丧失工作能力而失业之会员，经至少两名本会会员签署证明，并经行政委员会调查批准后，可向特别福利委员会申请领取月度津贴。然而，此津贴仅发给入会至少六个月之会员。
e) 会员身故后，其家属可根据特别福利委员会制定的规章，向该委员会申请津贴。

第十条.- 任何违反上述第八条规定之会员，将由行政委员会给予书面警告，或视违规性质予以除名。

第十一条.- 任何改变职业或申请退出本会之会员，必须书面陈述理由。只有经行政委员会许可，方可退出本会。其所缴款项不予退还。

第十二条.- 若会员涉及下列情形之一，行政委员会将命令将其除名并告知此举；此外，须向会员大会报告：-
a) 拖欠会费三个月或以上者（荣誉会员或失业者除外）。
b) 在外商机构任职而未通知本会即离职者。

c) if he has not been rehabilitated after having

Chapter III. --Organization.

Article 13.- The general meeting of members is the

Article 14.- The Association has an Administrative

by the general meeting of members.

Article 15.- The Association has a Supervisory
Committee charged with supervising the affairs of the
Association. This Committee is composed of 5 members
and 2 reserve members elected by the general meeting
of members.

Article 16.- The Administrative Committee will
designate 3 permanent administrators to be responsible for
the affairs of the Association. One of them will be
elected Chairman.

f) 不遵守本会章程及决议，或不承担赋予其责任者。
g) 借本会名义谋取私利者。

第三章.--组织。

第十三条.- 会员大会为本会最高权力机构。

第十四条.- 本会设行政委员会，负责执行和管理本会事务。该委员会由会员大会选举产生的9名行政委员和4名候补行政委员组成。

第十五条.- 本会设监察委员会，负责监督本会事务。该委员会由会员大会选举产生的5名委员和2名候补委员组成。

第十六条.- 行政委员会将指定3名常务行政委员负责本会事务。其中一人将当选为主席。

Article 17.- The Supervisory Committee will
designate 2 permanent members to supervise all the work
of the Association.

Article 18.- The Standing Administrative
Committee has the following departments under its control:
a) General Affairs. b) Finance.
c) Inquiries. d) Arbitration. e) Public
Welfare. f) Representation.

The General Affairs Department consists of a
Chief, one secretary and two clerks. The other
departments have each one chief and two clerks. They
may engage assistants if necessary and pay them wages
or locomotion allowances.

Article 19.- In order to facilitate the work
and development of the Association, the Administration
Committee may establish:
a) A special Friendship Group.
b) A Special Welfare Committee.

Article 20.- These special Committees will each
have a chief and a deputy chief elected from among the
members of the Administrative Committee or engaged by
the Committee.

Article 21. - The duties of the Administrative
Committee are as follows:-
a) To enforce the decisions of the general
meeting of members.
b) To attend to all external affairs of the
Association, to carry out or to conclude contracts
with the outside world as the representative of
the Association.
c) To elaborate the bye-laws and the
regulations of the internal service of the
Administrative Committee, the Special Welfare
Committee and the Special Friendship Committee.
d) To convoke the general meeting of
members.
e) To procure money as a fund of the
Association and to open special contributions for
this purpose.

第十八条.- 常务行政委员会下设以下部门：
a) 总务部。 b) 财务部。
c) 问询部。 d) 仲裁部。 e) 福利部。 f) 代表部。

总务部设主任一名、秘书一名及办事员两名。其他各部各设主任一名及办事员两名。如有需要，可聘请助理并支付其工资或交通津贴。

第十九条.- 为促进本会工作及发展，行政委员会可设立：
a) 特别联谊组。
b) 特别福利委员会。

第二十条.- 这些特别委员会各设主任和副主任一名，从行政委员会委员中选举产生或由委员会聘任。

第二十一条. - 行政委员会之职责如下：-
a) 执行会员大会之决议。
b) 处理本会一切对外事务，作为本会代表与外界签订或履行合同。
c) 制定行政委员会、特别福利委员会及特别联谊委员会的内部服务章程及规章。
d) 召集会员大会。
e) 筹集本会基金，并为此目的发起特别捐款。

Article 22.- The duties of the Supervisory
Committee are as follows:-
a) To examine the budget, the statement of
accounts and the daily accounts.
b) To attend the meetings of the Administrative
Committee. (However, the members of the Supervisory
Committee will not have the right to vote).
c) To manage the funds and the property of the
Association.
d) To watch the activities of members and to
prepare impeachments.

Chapter IV.-- Meetings.
Article 24.- Members will hold a general meeting
once a year. It will be convoked by the Administrative
Committee. In case of necessity or upon the demand of at
least one-tenth of the members a general meeting of members
may be convoked at any time.
Article 25.-- The Administrative Committee will
hold a meeting every two months; it will be convoked by the
Standing administrators. The Standing Administrative
Committee will meet once a month; it will be convoked by
the Chairman. It may be convoked at any time in an
extraordinary case.
Article 26.- The Supervisory Committee will
meet every three months; it will be convoked by the Chairman
of the Supervisory Committee. It may be convoked at any
time in an extraordinary case.

Chapter V.-- Fees.
Article 27.- The expenses of the Association
will be defrayed by the following receipts:-
A.--Subscriptions from members.
i) Admission fees: $2
ii) Badge fees: $1

第四章.--会议。
第二十四条.- 会员每年举行一次大会。由行政委员会召集。如有必要或经至少十分之一会员要求，可随时召集会员大会。
第二十五条.-- 行政委员会每两个月举行一次会议；由常务行政委员召集。常务行政委员会每月开会一次；由主席召集。遇特殊情况可随时召集。
第二十六条.- 监察委员会每三个月开会一次；由监察委员会主席召集。遇特殊情况可随时召集。

第五章.--费用。
第二十七条.- 本会经费由以下收入支付：-
A.--会员会费。
i) 入会费：$2
ii) 徽章费：$1

authorities.

ANNEX II - (g)

Letter from a lift-man of Cathay Mansions on
Rue Bourgeat addressed to members of the Executive Committee
and the Supervisory Committee of the Mutual Aid Association
of Chinese Employees of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai.

On the introduction of Mr. Zeng, I have been
working during the past six months as substitute lift-man
at the Cathay Mansions. The work is heavy and the pay
is the minimum. I have borne with this only in the hope
of better days to come.

On August 9, the proprietor of the hotel
desired to engage 3 lift-men. I was very happy upon
learning of this. However, on the following day, I
was dismissed. Astonished, I went to the manager's
office for information and I learned that he had
no intention to dismiss me. I then went to see the
Sub-manager who promised to engage me, but the foreman
Zi Kia Fong and Lou King Ling of the lift service induced
the sub-manager to dismiss me. However, they are also
members of your association and your object is to develop
the welfare and the spirit of mutual aid. They not only
failed to come to my assistance but, using their position
they oppressed us. All this is contrary to the principal
object of your Association.

For some time now, I have tried to join
your Association on the introduction of member Tseng Ou
but Mr. Ou Ze Yong, Chairman of the Administrative
Committee of your Association, informed Mr. Zeng that
in view of the fact that I was a substitute, it was
not necessary for me to join the Association.

附件二 - (g)

勃艮第路 (Rue Bourgeat) 国泰公寓 (Cathay Mansions) 一名电梯服务员致上海外商旅馆华籍员工互助协会执行委员会和监察委员会成员之信函。

经曾先生介绍，过去六个月我在国泰公寓担任临时电梯服务员。工作繁重，薪水最低。我忍受这一切，只希望将来情况好转。

8月9日，酒店业主欲雇用3名电梯服务员。得知此事我非常高兴。然而，次日我被解雇。我感到惊讶，前往经理办公室询问，得知他无意解雇我。随后我去见副经理，他承诺雇用我，但电梯服务领班 Zi Kia Fong 和 Lou King Ling 唆使副经理解雇我。然而，他们也是贵会会员，而贵会的宗旨是增进福利和互助精神。他们不仅未予协助，反而利用职位压迫我们。这一切都与贵会的主要宗旨相悖。

一段时间以来，我曾试图经会员曾欧 (Tseng Ou) 介绍加入贵会，但贵会行政委员会主席欧泽永 (Ou Ze Yong) 先生告知曾先生，鉴于我是临时工，没有必要加入本会。

（批：FILE）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 1941）

Le 17 août 1941 à 16 heures 30, nous nous sommes
rendus au 218 Route Prentice où se tenait une réu-
nion non autorisée des membres principaux de l'Associa-
tion de secours mutuel des employés chinois des hôtels
étrangers de Shanghai (上海外商旅館業華員互助會). (1)
Suivant les instructions reçues et avec l'aide de
4 agents du Poste Central, nous avons appréhendé les
personnes présentes, au nombre de 18. L'assemblée était
composée de 7 employés des "Cathay Mansions", 3 de "Ha-
milton House", 4 du "Metropole Hotel, 3 du "Cathay Ho-
tel" et d'un représentant du Comité d'orientation des
mouvements sociaux, nommé WANG YIH SAN (王逸三).
Le but de la réunion, convoquée par le Comité d'o-
rientation des mouvements sociaux, était la prise of-
ficielle de leurs fonctions par les membres des comités
de l'Association précitée. Rappelons que cette dernière
a été inaugurée le 3 août dans les locaux de la Chambre
de Commerce Chinoise, North Honan Road.
... ...

mai 1927.

1941年8月17日16时30分，我们前往普伦蒂斯路（Route Prentice）218号，那里正在举行上海外商旅馆业华员互助会（上海外商旅館業華員互助會）主要成员的未经批准的会议。(1)
根据收到的指示，并在中央巡捕房4名警员的协助下，我们逮捕了在场的18人。与会者包括7名“国泰公寓”（Cathay Mansions）职员、3名“汉密尔顿大厦”（Hamilton House）职员、4名“大都会饭店”（Metropole Hotel）职员、3名“国泰饭店”（Cathay Hotel）职员，以及一名社会运动指导委员会代表，名为王逸三（WANG YIH SAN）。
此次会议由社会运动指导委员会召集，目的是让上述互助会各委员会成员正式就职。需指出的是，该互助会已于8月3日在北河南路中国商会会所内成立。

Annexe II - 8.

Lettre au personnel du "Sassoon House" adressée à l'Asso-
ciation de secours mutuel des employés chinois des hôtels
étrangers de Shanghai.

- : -

Messieurs,

Depuis que votre association s'est fait enregistrer au
Gouvernement municipal, vous déployez une grande activité;
non seulement vous faites preuve de bravoure dans la protec-
tion des membres, mais encore (vous avez créé) une union
sincère. Cela mérite notre admiration. En vue de resserrer
les liens d'amitié et de concentrer nos forces, nous comp-
tons nous affilier (à votre association) afin de pouvoir
recevoir des conseils en temps voulu. Comme votre associa-
tion est à la tête de la société, nous pensons que vous ne
refuserez pas notre demande. D'ailleurs, nous sommes tous
collègues de la maison Sassoon. Nous pensons que vous ferez
bon accueil à notre requête.

Le 7 août 1941.

Annexe II - d

Statuts de l'Association de secours mutuel des employés
chinois des hôtels étrangers de Shanghai.

-:-

Manifeste à l'occasion de l'inauguration de l'Association
de secours mutuel des employés chinois des hôtels étran-
gers de Shanghai:

Depuis le développement des transports maritimes
et du commerce, le nombre des Européens et des Américains
qui viennent faire le commerce en Chine s'accroît de jour
en jour. Comme Shanghai est un important port de commerce
où sont groupés des commerçants, les affaires des hôtels
étrangers y deviennent de jour en jour plus florissantes.
A présent, le nombre de nos camarades à Shanghai s'élève
à 10.000 environ; la majorité d'entre eux travaillent
péniblement et ont des cals aux mains et aux pieds, alors
que les Etrangers, profitant de leur suprématie politique
et économique, exercent une oppression déraisonnable sur
eux et nous outragent. Non seulement notre traitement est
tellement modique qu'il nous est difficile de nous vêtir
et nourrir suffisamment, mais encore nous n'avons aucune
garantie dans l'exercice de notre profession. Il n'existe
ni rente viagère pour notre (retraite) par suite de vieil-
lesse ou d'invalidité, ni indemnité pour maladie ou décès.
Depuis les hostilités à Shanghai, la valeur des devises
étrangères augmente considérablement, et celle de la
monnaie légale diminue. Après avoir été victimes des
malheurs de guerre, nous souffrons encore de la cherté
de la vie. Actuellement, toutes les entreprises accordent
des augmentations de salaire et des indemnités (à leurs
...........
page_data.zh:
附件二 - d

上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助协会章程。

-:-

上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助协会成立宣言：

自海运与贸易发展以来，来华经商之欧美人士日益增多。上海作为商贾云集的重要通商口岸，外商旅馆业务日渐繁荣。目前，我在沪同仁约有10,000人；大多数人辛勤劳作，手足生茧，而外人凭借其在政治和经济上的优势地位，对我们进行无理压迫和侮辱。我们的待遇不仅微薄，难以维持基本的衣食，而且在职业上毫无保障。既无因年老或残疾导致的退休养老金，也无疾病或死亡抚恤金。自上海战事爆发以来，外币价值大幅上涨，法币价值下跌。我们在遭受战祸之余，又深受生活成本高昂之苦。目前，各企业均向其...........

page_data.en:
Annexe II - d                                                                 Page 2

employés) pour leur permettre de vivre; seuls les employés
chinois des hôtels (étrangers), au contraire, sont menacés
de réduction de salaire et de licenciement. Depuis plusi-
eurs dizaines d'années, sous l'oppression des étrangers,
nous vivons comme des esclaves. Tout cela est dû au man-
que d'union.
    Nous, employés chinois des hôtels (étrangers), n'a-
vons jamais eu d'organisation nous permettant de resserrer
nos liens d'amitié, ni l'occasion de nous unir, en sorte
que nous sommes dispersés comme du sable, il nous était
inutile de parler d'assistance mutuelle et de collabora-
tion.
    En conséquence, nous organisons l'Association d'as-
sistance mutuelle des employés chinois des hôtels étran-
gers de Shanghai. Grâce aux efforts de nos membres fer-
vents pendant 6 mois et à l'assistance de la plupart de
nos camarades, la dite Association vient d'être officiel-
lement inaugurée. Désormais elle cherchera, conformément
au but qu'elle s'est fixé, à obtenir une union spirituelle
et sincère, une assistance mutuelle et une collaboration
matérielle de nos camarades chinois des hôtels étrangers.
    Comme il y va du bien-être de nos membres, nous es-
pérons qu'ils feront chacun de leur mieux pour assurer
la bonne marche (de l'Association). L'avenir de notre
Association dépendra de ces (efforts).

（员工）发放加薪和津贴以维持生计；唯独外商旅馆的华籍职员反而面临减薪和解雇的威胁。数十年来，在外人的压迫下，我们过着奴隶般的生活。这一切皆因缺乏团结所致。
    我们外商旅馆的华籍职员，从未有过能够增进友谊的组织，也没有联合的机会，因此我们如散沙一般，无从谈起互助与合作。
    鉴于此，我们组织成立了上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助协会。经过热心会员六个月的努力以及大多数同仁的协助，该协会已正式 inaugurated（成立）。今后，它将按照既定宗旨，寻求我外商旅馆华籍同仁在精神上的真诚团结，以及在物质上的互助与合作。
    这关系到会员的福祉，我们希望各位各尽所能，确保（协会）的良好运作。我们协会的未来将取决于这些（努力）。

Statuts de l'Association d'assistance mutuelle des employés chinois des hôtels étrangers de Shanghai:

Chapitre I - Principes généraux.

Art. 1 - Notre Association étant formée par les employés chinois des hôtels étrangers de la ville (y compris les hôtels, pensions, restaurants, bars, cafés, etc., grands ou petits, exploités par des étrangers), se dénomme : "Association d'assistance mutuelle des employés chinois des hôtels étrangers de Shanghai".

Art. 2 - La présente Association a pour but de resserrer les liens d'amitié, (procéder à) l'échange de connaissances, de réformer les (mauvaises) habitudes, de (pratiquer) l'entraide, de préconiser l'esprit de collaboration et d'accélérer le bien-être de nos membres.

Art. 3 - Le siège de l'Association se trouve provisoirement au No 216 rue Prentice, Concession Française, Shanghai.

Chapitre II - Membres.

Art. 4 - Peut être membre de notre Association, tout Chinois, quels que soient son sexe, et son âge, qui travaille dans les hôtels, restaurants, pensions, bars, cafés, exploités par les Etrangers dans notre ville.

Art. 5 - Quiconque approuve le but de notre association et désire s'y affilier ne pourra y être admis comme membre que s'il satisfait aux conditions suivantes : avoir rempli le bulletin d'adhésion; être présenté par 2 membres au moins de l'Association; être agréé par le Comité d administration.

上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助协会章程：

第一章 - 总则。

第一条 - 本会由本市外商旅馆（包括外国人经营的大小旅馆、公寓、餐馆、酒吧、咖啡馆等）的华籍职员组成，定名为：“上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助协会”。

第二条 - 本会旨在增进友谊，（进行）知识交流，革除（不良）习惯，（实行）互助，提倡合作精神，并加速提升会员福祉。

第三条 - 本会会址暂设于上海法租界普恩济思路（Prentice Road）216号。

第二章 - 会员。

第四条 - 凡在本市外国人经营的旅馆、餐馆、公寓、酒吧、咖啡馆工作的中国人，不分性别和年龄，均可成为本会会员。

第五条 - 凡赞同本会宗旨并愿加入者，须满足以下条件方可被接纳为会员：填写入会申请书；由至少两名本会会员介绍；经理事会批准。

son admission, verser les frais d'admission et remplir une

Tout changement (d adresse) devra être signalé en temps
voulu à l'Association; cette formalité est destinée à
faciliter les réunions, le cas échéant.

Art. 7 - Tout membre démissionnaire qui désire s'af-

Art. 8 - Les membres de l'Association doivent se sou-

a) Observer les statuts et les décisions de l Associa-

b) Mettre à exécution, près les heures de travail,
les instructions relatives à la réforme et à l'assistance
mutuelle, ainsi que les décisions de l'Association,

par l'Association;

c) Payer régulièrement la cotisation et effectuer les
enquêtes ordonnées par l'Association;

d) Faire de la propagande en faveur de l'Association
et présenter le plus possible de nouveaux membres afin de
consolider les bases de l'Association;

e) Assister aux réunions de l'Association, aux heures
indiquées;

f) Ne pas entraver le service d'autrui;

g) Ne pas exercer concurremment une autre profession
illicite;

h) Assister de son mieux, tout membre décédé ou malade,
qui se trouve dans une situation précaire; en cas de néces-
sité, une souscription pourra être ouverte pour lui venir

第六条 - 所有会员在入会时，须缴纳入会费并填写履历表，注明最新地址。任何（地址）变更须及时通知本会；此手续旨在便于必要时召开会议。

第七条 - 任何退会后希望重新加入本会的会员，须像新会员一样办理入会手续。

第八条 - 本会会员须履行以下义务：

a) 遵守本会章程及决议；

b) 在工作时间之外，执行有关改革和互助的指示以及本会的决议，接受本会委派的任务和工作；

c) 定期缴纳会费，并执行本会命令的调查；

d) 为本会进行宣传，尽可能介绍新会员，以巩固本会基础；

e) 按规定时间出席本会会议；

f) 不妨碍他人的服务；

g) 不得同时从事其他非法职业；

h) 尽力援助处于困境中的患病或去世会员；如有必要，可发起募捐以资帮助

Art. 9 - Les membres de l'Association jouissent des
droits suivants :

a) faire les propositions, soumettre les projets
de statuts et de règlements de l'Association.

b) droit de vote et d'éligibilité;

c) droit de jouir des avantages de l'Association;

d) Tout membre atteint par la vieillesse ou
par une maladie ou suite d'invalidité,
pourra se faire accorder une aide par le Comité
spécial du bien-être, sur demande écrite), accompagnée

aura été approuvée par le Comité d'administration, après

e) En cas de décès d'un membre, sa famille pourra sol-
liciter une indemnité du comité spécial du bien-être, con-

Art. 10 - Tout membre qui viole l'une des dispositions
énumérées à l'art. 8, sera l'objet d'un avertissement écrit,
ou de la révocation suivant le cas, par le Comité d'adminis-
tration.

Art. 11 - Tout membre qui change de métier ou qui de-
mande à se retirer de l'Association, devra en énoncer par
écrit les motifs; il ne pourra se retirer de l'Association
qu'après approbation du Comité d'administration. Les sommes

Art. 12 - Si un membre se trouve dans l'un des cas
suivants, le Comité d'administration prononcera sa révo-
cation et en préviendra le révoqué; il devra en outre
en rendre compte à l'assemblée générale des membres :
a) s'il est en retard de trois mois ou davantage pour
le paiement de sa cotisation; (exception est faite pour
les membres honoraires et pour les enfants);
b) s'il quitte son emploi dans un établissement
étranger, sans en prévenir l'association;
c) s'il n'est pas réhabilité après avoir été privé
de ses droits civiques;
d) s'il a été condamné par le tribunal pour un acte
illégal;
e) s'il contracte une mauvaise habitude ou commet
un acte contraire à la discipline, et s'il persiste à ne
pas se corriger malgré les conseils réitérés;
f) s'il n'observe pas les statuts et les décisions
de l'association, ou n'assume pas la responsabilité qui
lui incombe;
g) s'il cherche à réaliser des bénéfices personnels
au nom de l'association;
h) s'il porte atteinte au crédit et aux intérêts
de l'association.

e) 染上恶习或做出违反纪律的行为，且经反复劝告仍不改正者；
f) 不遵守本会章程和决议，或不承担其应尽责任者；
g) 借本会名义谋取个人利益者；

Comité est composé de 9 administrateurs et 4 administra-
teurs suppléants élus par l'assemblée générale des membres.
Art. 15 - L'association a un Comité de contrôle chargé
de contrôler les affaires de l'association. Ce comité est
composé de 5 membres et de 2 membres suppléants élus par
l'assemblée générale des membres.
Art. 16 - Le Comité d'administration désigne 3 ad-
ministrateurs permanents comme responsables de toutes les
affaires de l'association; l'un d'eux est élu président.
Art. 17 - Le Comité de contrôle désigne 2 membres
permanents pour contrôler toutes les affaires de l'asso-
ciation.
Art. 18 - Le Comité permanent d'administration a,
sous ses ordres, les sections suivantes :
1) Affaires générales; 2) Finances; 3) Enquêtes;
4) Arbitrage; 5) Bien-être public; 6) Représentation .
La Section des affaires générales comprend un chef,
1 secrétaire, 2 clercs. Les autres sections ont chacune
un chef et 2 clercs. Elles peuvent engager des commis,
suivant leurs besoins et leur payer des salaires ou des
frais de déplacement.
Art. 19 - Le Comité d'administration pourra créer:
1) Une Amicale spéciale; 2) un Comité spécial du bien-être
afin de faciliter le développement des affaires de l'asso-
ciation.
Art. 20 - Ces Comités spéciaux auront chacun un chef
et un sous-chef, élus au sein du Comité d'administration
ou engagés par celui-ci.

理事会由会员大会选举产生的9名理事和4名候补理事组成。
第十五条 - 本会设监事会，负责监督本会事务。该委员会由会员大会选举产生的5名监事和2名候补监事组成。
第十六条 - 理事会指定3名常务理事负责本会所有事务；其中一人当选为主席。
第十七条 - 监事会指定2名常任监事监督本会所有事务。
第十八条 - 常务理事会下设以下各组：
1) 总务组；2) 财务组；3) 调查组；
4) 仲裁组；5) 公共福利组；6) 交际组。
总务组设组长一名，秘书一名，办事员两名。其他各组各设组长一名，办事员两名。各组可根据需要雇佣职员，并向其支付薪水或差旅费。
第十九条 - 理事会可设立：
1) 特别联谊会；2) 福利特别委员会，以促进本会事务的发展。
第二十条 - 这些特别委员会各设主任和副主任一名，由理事会内部选举产生或由理事会聘任。

Art. 21 - Les attributions du comité d'administra-
tion sont les suivantes :
a) Mettre à exécution les décisions prises par
l'assemblée générale des membres;
b) S'occuper de toutes les affaires intérieures
de l'association; exécuter ou conclure des contrats avec
l'extérieur au titre de représentant l'association.
c) Elaborer les statuts et les règlements du ser-
vice intérieur du comité d'administration, du comité
spécial du bien-être et de l'école spéciale;
d) Convoquer l'assemblée générale des membres;
e) Se procurer de l'argent pour constituer les
fonds de l'association, et ouvrir des souscriptions
spéciales (à cet effet).
f) Fixer le budget et rédiger les arrêtés de comptes
de l'exercice annuel;
g) Nommer et destituer les commis ou les employés.
Art. 22 - Les attributions du Comité de contrôle
sont les suivantes :
a) Examiner le budget, les arrêtés de comptes et les
comptes journaliers;
b) Assister aux réunions du Comité d'administration
(toutefois, les membres du comité de contrôle n'ont pas
le droit de vote);
c) Gérer les fonds et les biens de l'association;
d) Surveiller les actes des membres et s'occuper
de leur mise en accusation;
Art. 23 - Les membres des comités d'administration
et du contrôle sont élus pour un an, et sont rééligibles.

Chapitre IV - Réunions

Art. 24 - Les membres se réuniront en assemblée
générale une fois par an; ils seront convoqués par le
Comité d'administration. En cas de nécessité, ou sur
demande de 1/10 des membres au moins, l'assemblée géné-
rale pourra être convoquée à tout moment.

Art. 25 - Le Comité d'administration se réunira
tous les deux mois; il sera convoqué par les administra-
teurs permanents. Le Comité permanent d'administration
se réunira une fois par mois; il sera convoqué par son
président; il pourra être convoqué à tout moment, pour
cause extraordinaire.

Art. 26 - Le Comité de contrôle se réunira tous
les trois mois; il sera convoqué par le président du
comité de contrôle; il pourra être convoqué à tout mo-
ment pour cause extraordinaire.

Chapitre V - Frais

Art. 27 - Les dépenses de l'association seront cou-
vertes par les recettes suivantes :

a) Cotisations des membres

1) Frais d'admission $ 2.00; frais d'insigne $1.
2) Cotisation des membres honoraires : $50
versée en 1 seule fois;
3) Cotisation mensuelle des membres ordinaires:
$2;
4) Des souscriptions spéciales pourront être
ouvertes si les fonds sont insuffisants à couvrir les
dépenses ordinaires.

b) Création de la caisse de l'Association.

Lettre adressée par un nommé TSU ZEU OU à M. FU
membre du Comité de direction de l'Association de
secours mutuel des employés chinois des hôtels étran-
gers de Shanghai.

Il y a deux semaines que notre association a été
inaugurée. Aujourd'hui est le jour de l'entrée en fonc-
tion des membres des comités de direction et de contrôle
J'en suis très joyeux. J'ai conservé provisoirement la
liste des membres de notre association depuis le jour
où elle a été mise sur pied, jusqu'à son inauguration.
Comme des hommes de talent se sont groupés que nous
avons devant nous des gens capables et que j'ai terminé
ma mission par intérim, je vous prie de désigner quel-
qu'un pour prendre possession de la liste des membres
afin de développer les affaires de l'association.
Le 17 août 1941

Annexe II - g

Lettre d'un boy d'ascenseur du "Cathay Pensions",
rue Bour est adressée aux membres des Comités de direc-
tion et de contrôle de l'association d'assistance mutuel-
le des (employés chinois) des hôtels étrangers :

Sur introduction de M. r. Zeng, je travaille au ser-
vice des ascenseurs du "Cathay Pensions" comme remplaçant
depuis 6 mois. Le travail est pénible, et le salaire est
minime. (J'ai supporté cela) tout simplement pour atten-
dre des jours meilleurs.

Le courant, le patron de l'hôtel voulait engager
3 boys d'ascenseur. Je fus très heureux d'apprendre
cette nouvelle. Toutefois, le lendemain, je fus révoqué.
Etonné, je me présentai au bureau du manager pour me
renseigner, et on m'a dit que celui-ci n'avait pas
l'intention (de me révoquer). Puis j'allai voir le
sub-manager qui me promit de m'engager. Mais le contre-
maître Li Kin Yong et Lou Ming Ling du service des
ascenseurs escortèrent le sub-manager à me licencier.
(Cependant) ils sont également membres de votre associa-
tion et votre but est de développer le bien-être et l'es-
prit d'assistance mutuelle. Non seulement ils ne sont
pas venus à mon aide, mais encore ils exercent une oppres-
sion sur moi en profitant de leur situation prépondérante,
ce qui est contraire au but principal de votre Associa-
tion. Il y a quelque temps, j'ai (essayé) de m'affilier
à votre association sur présentation du membre Tsong Ou,
mais M. Ou Ze Yong, président du comité d'administra-
tion de votre association, a répondu à Mr. Zeng qu'étant
donné que j'étais un remplaçant, il ne m'était pas néces-

..........
page_data.zh:
附件二 - g

一封来自布尔路 (Rue Bourgeat) “Cathay Pensions” 电梯侍者的信，致外商旅馆（华籍职员）互助会的指导和监察委员会委员：

经曾先生 (Mr. r. Zeng) 介绍，我在 “Cathay Pensions” 担任电梯替班侍者已有6个月。工作辛苦，薪水微薄。（我忍受这一切）只是为了等待更好的日子。

最近，旅馆老板想招聘3名电梯侍者。得知此消息我非常高兴。然而，第二天我就被解雇了。我感到惊讶，便去经理办公室询问，被告知他无意（解雇我）。随后我去见副经理，他承诺雇用我。但是，电梯部的领班李金荣 (Li Kin Yong) 和楼明林 (Lou Ming Ling) 陪同副经理将我辞退。（然而）他们也是贵协会的会员，而贵协会的宗旨是增进福利和互助精神。他们不仅没有来帮助我，反而利用其优势地位对我进行压迫，这与贵协会的主要宗旨相悖。前段时间，我曾试图经会员宗欧 (Tsong Ou) 介绍加入贵协会，但贵协会管理委员会主席欧泽勇 (Ou Ze Yong) 先生回复曾先生说，鉴于我是替班人员，我不必

..........

page_data.en:
Annexe II - P                                                                 page 5

sire de m'affilier à l'association. Cependant d'après
les dispositions de l'art. 2 de vos statuts, je possède
les qualités pour être membre de votre association. J'ai
perdu mon emploi actuel, il m'est difficile d'en trouver
un ailleurs. En conséquence, je me permets de vous exposer
les conditions de ma révocation et l'oppression dont
je suis victime en vous priant de me venir en aide.

Signé : Vong Jen Pao,
N° 4 cité Yong Eu Li, rue Wagner

Le 15 Août.

Shanghai, August 5, 1941.

Subject: Mutual Aid Association of Chinese Employees
of Foreign Hotels in Shanghai (上海市洋商旅業華員互助會)
Reference: Labour Movement

There are in the two Settlements about 120
hotels, boarding houses, restaurants, cabarets, cafes, etc.
(of which 20 are in the French Concession) operated by
foreigners and employing in all some 10,000 boys, cooks,
coolies, etc.

Employees of Foreign hotels in Shanghai" was formed at the
Social Movement Direction Committee at No.527 Range Road,
on the proposal of the following persons:-
Wu Se Yung (吳士榮), No.1 boy of the Cathay
Hotel, Sassoon House, Nanking Road.

restaurant of the Cathay Mansions.

1941, in the course of a meeting held at the Chinese Chamber
of Commerce. During the meeting the following Committees
were elected:-

上海，1941年8月5日。

主题：上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助会 (上海市洋商旅業華員互助會)
参考：劳工运动

两租界内约有120家由外国人经营的旅馆、公寓、餐馆、歌舞厅、咖啡馆等（其中20家在法租界），共雇佣约10,000名侍者、厨师、苦力等。

最近，在兰路 (Range Road) 527号社会运动指导委员会的提议下，成立了“上海外商旅馆华籍职员互助会”，提议人如下：
吴士荣 (Wu Se Yung)，南京路沙逊大厦 (Sassoon House) 国泰饭店 (Cathay Hotel) 头号侍者。

王永坚 (Wang Yung Kieh)，国泰公寓餐厅头号侍者。
郑贻斌 (Chen Yieh Ping)，江西路 (Kiangse Road) 180号大都会饭店 (Metropole Hotel) 侍者。

该协会于1941年8月3日在上海总商会举行的会议上正式成立。会议期间选举产生了以下委员会：

Strike of Cathay, Metropole Hotels and
6th floor Hamilton House employees.

At 11a.m. 27/8/41, D.S. Cooke again interviewed
Mr. J.G. Lipsman, General Manager of the Cathay Hotels
Ltd, regarding the strike situation.

At about 8.30p.m. 25/8/41, the strikers' delegation
was received by Mr. Lipsman and it was apparent that
they had come to sign the conditions as described in
diary 3 of this file, which is a necessary factor before
they are permitted to resume work. They had also agreed
that 11 Restaurant staff, 10 cooks, 9 Tower staff and
3 telephone operators of the Cathay Hotel, four of the
staff of the Metropole Hotel and 33 staff of the Cathay
Mansions should not be re-employed. They were prevented
from signing by the sudden arrival of a male Chinese, who
talked to them and after which they all left.

On 22/8/41, Mr. Lipsman, after a conference with
the Chairman of the company, presented the strikers with
10 conditions under which they could resumed work. These
conditions augment those already presented, and are as
follows:-

1. I shall take back only those employees whose services
I require.

2. I shall take back only one Night Telephone-operator.
All the other Telephone-operators will be replaced by
girls from the Shanghai Telephone Company.

员工罢工。

1941年8月27日上午11时，Cooke侦探长再次会见了
华懋饭店有限公司总经理 J.G. Lipsman先生，商讨罢工
局势。

1941年8月25日晚上约8时30分，Lipsman先生接见了
罢工者代表团，显然他们是来签署本卷宗日记3中所述的
条件，这是允许他们复工的必要前提。他们还同意不再
雇佣华懋饭店的11名餐厅员工、10名厨师、9名塔楼员工
和3名电话接线员，都城饭店的4名员工以及华懋公寓的
33名员工。一名中国男子突然到来并与他们交谈，阻止了
他们签字，随后他们全部离开。

1941年8月22日，Lipsman先生在与公司董事长会议后，
向罢工者提出了10项复工条件。这些条件是对已提出条件
的补充，具体如下：-

1. 我只收回那些我需要其服务的员工。

2. 我只收回一名夜间电话接线员。其他所有电话接线员
将由上海电话公司的女接线员取代。

page_data.en:
2/2.

3. I have authorised Mr. Stahley, Manager of Cathay
Hotel, Mr. Arregger, Manager of Metropole Hotel,
Mr. Carreau, Manager of Cathay Mansions and Mr.
P. Bavard, Manager of Kitchens of Cathay Hotels
Limited to take back only those employees, whose
services they require.

4. I am the sole person who has the full right to
transfer from one department to another, or from
one Hotel to another any Chinese employee of our
Company, and, upon my orders, the Managers of the
Hotels or Kitchens have the right to effect such
transfers.

I shall not tolerate any discussion on this matter,
my orders will have to be complied with, without any
argument.

5. I have the full authority to dismiss any employee,
without previous notice.

It is understood however, that such action on my
part will be provoked only by misconduct, failure
to obey orders, bad execution of work, or joining
the Union.

6. In case notice is given due to the organisation of
the Hotels or for reasons of service, the employee
dismissed is granted the following indemnity:

15 days salary and rice allowance plus service
charge average for previous month, for every
year of service.

7. In case notice is given due to negligence on the part
of the employee in performing his duties, or
disobedience, bad discipline, theft etc., the
employee thus dismissed it not entitled to any
indemnity whatsoever.

8. In case of death of any employee, the family of the
deceased is entitled to the indemnity as granted in
paragraph 1, plus one hundred Shanghai dollars
(Sh$100.-) for funeral expenses.

9. In case of illness or accident occuring during the
performance of duties, if such illness or accident
page_data.zh:
2/2.

3. 我已授权华懋饭店经理Stahley先生、都城饭店经理
Arregger先生、华懋公寓经理Carreau先生以及华懋饭
店有限公司厨房经理P. Bavard先生，只收回他们需要
其服务的员工。

4. 我是唯一拥有全权将本公司任何中国员工从一个部门
调至另一个部门，或从一家酒店调至另一家酒店的人，
并且根据我的命令，酒店或厨房经理有权执行此类调动。

我不容忍对此事的任何讨论，我的命令必须无条件
服从，不得有任何争辩。

5. 我拥有无需预先通知即可解雇任何员工的全权。

但需理解的是，我采取此类行动仅由不当行为、不服
从命令、工作执行不力或加入工会引起。

6. 如果因酒店组织或服务原因发出解雇通知，被解雇的
员工将获得以下赔偿：

每服务一年，支付15天的薪金和米贴，加上上一个
月的小费平均值。

7. 如果因员工履行职责时的疏忽、违抗命令、纪律涣散、
盗窃等原因发出解雇通知，被解雇的员工无权获得任
何赔偿。

8. 如有员工死亡，死者家属有权获得第1款规定的赔偿，
外加一百上海元（Sh$100.-）作为丧葬费。

9. 如在履行职责期间发生疾病或事故，如果该疾病或事故

page_data.en:
4/3.

is certified by a Doctor nominated by the Company
or the Lester Chinese Hospital, the employee is
entitled, providing his illness does not exceed
forty-five days (45) to his salary, rice allowance
and his share in the service charge.

If his illness exceeds forty-five days, he will be
dismissed and he will be entitled to the indemnity
granted in paragraph No.1, which indemnity will
start from the first day of his illness, after
deduction of the 45 days salary etc. already paid.

10. The Strikers will not receive any salary, Rice-
allowance and Service Charge for the days they were
on strike.

The 18 employees arrested by the French Police were
released at 3p.m., 26/8/41, and it was expected that as
a result of this the employees would accept the conditions.
Mr. Lipsman was advised by M. Paul Premet, Advocate who
is acting for the families of the arrested and for the
Union, that the employees would return to work as soon as
the men were released, he has however since telephoned to
Mr. Lipman informing him that the men would not return.

On 26/8/41, Mr. Lipsman sent a notice to the
striking employees, informing them, that if they did not
sign the 10 conditions and resume work as from 12 noon,
27/8/41, they would be considered as having definitely
refused to resume work and could receive their salaries
due to them up to 18/8/41. A further communication from
Mr. Lipsman revealed that the "dead-line" had been
extended to 6p.m. 27/8/41.
page_data.zh:
4/3.

经公司指定医生或雷士德华人医院证明，且病情不超
过四十五天（45），则该员工有权获得其薪金、米贴
及其在小费中的份额。

如果病情超过四十五天，他将被解雇，并有权获得第1
款规定的赔偿，该赔偿将从其患病第一天起算，扣除
已支付的45天薪金等。

10. 罢工者在罢工期间不领取任何薪金、米贴和小费。

被法国警察逮捕的18名员工于1941年8月26日下午3时
获释，预计员工会因此接受这些条件。代表被捕者家属
和工会行事的律师Paul Premet先生建议Lipsman先生，
员工将在人员获释后立即复工，但他随后致电Lipman先
生，告知这些人不会回来。

1941年8月26日，Lipsman先生向罢工员工发出通知，
告知他们，如果他们不签署这10项条件并从1941年8月
27日中午12时起复工，将被视为坚决拒绝复工，只能领
取截至1941年8月18日的欠薪。Lipsman先生的进一步通
信显示，“最后期限”已延长至1941年8月27日下午6时。

INDUSTRIAL DISPUTE.

Some 650 Chinese employees of the following foreign hotels owned by the Cathay Hotels, Ltd., both in the Settlement and French Concession, declared a strike between 1 p.m. and 2.30 p.m., August 18, 1941, in order to enforce a demand for the release of 18 members of the Foreign Hotels Chinese Employees' Mutual Aid Society, 218 Route Prentice (F.C.), who were arrested by French police on August 17 for holding a meeting on the premises.

Name & Address No. of Hands Affected.
Cathay Hotel, Nanking Road. 250
Hamilton House (6th floor),
Kiangse Road. 40
Cathay Mansions, 265 Rue Bourgeat. 200
Metropole Hotel, 180 Kiangse Road. 150

Some 170 out of the 250 employees of the Cathay Hotel resumed work unconditionally on the morning of August 19, while the remaining 80 and those in the other three hotels continued to strike. The management engaged about 150 Jewish refugees in place of the striking employees.

Notices were posted at the entrances of the above four hotels on August 21, to the effect that the strike being unreasonable, the strikers would be permitted to resume work only on the management's conditions. The management would take back only those whose services were required and the employees must strictly observe the orders of the management.

On August 25, some 17 Chinese cooks were engaged by the Cathay Hotel. The 170 Chinese employees of the same hotel who resumed work unconditionally on August 19, continued their duties normally.

On the afternoon of August 26, the 18 members of the Foreign Hotels Chinese Employees' Mutual Aid Society, who were arrested by French police on August 17, were released after having furnished guarantees.

劳资纠纷。

由国泰饭店有限公司拥有的下列位于租界及法租界的外商酒店的约650名华籍员工，于1941年8月18日下午1时至2时30分之间宣布罢工，以迫使当局释放“外商旅馆华员互助会”（地址：法租界普恩济思路218号）的18名成员；这些人因于8月17日在该会址举行会议而被法国警察逮捕。

名称及地址 受影响人数。
南京路国泰饭店。 250
江西路汉密尔顿大厦（6楼）。 40
蒲石路265号国泰公寓。 200
江西路180号都城饭店。 150

国泰饭店250名员工中约有170人于8月19日上午无条件复工，而其余80人及其他三家酒店的员工继续罢工。管理层雇佣了约150名犹太难民替代罢工员工。

8月21日，上述四家酒店入口处张贴告示，称罢工不合理，罢工者仅在管理层提出的条件下方可获准复工。管理层仅收回所需之员工，且员工必须严格遵守管理层命令。

8月25日，国泰饭店雇佣了约17名华籍厨师。该酒店于8月19日无条件复工的170名华籍员工继续正常履行职责。

8月26日下午，8月17日被法国警察逮捕的“外商旅馆华员互助会”18名成员在提供担保后获释。

8月31日上午7时，中央捕房警察

Station/
arrested 18 strikers picketted outside the Cathay Hotel to
prevent employees from going to work.

At 2 p.m. on September 2, six employees' repre-
sentatives of the above four hotels, namely Wang Yang Chien
( ), Hwa Hsiao Ken ( ), Hu Sing Shan ( ),
Zee Kwang Ping ( ), Chen Ih Ping ( ) and
Chao Mai Chun ( ), called in the office of the
Industrial and Social Division and submitted a petition
requesting mediation. They stated that the employees had
no demands and would resume work without conditions or
dismissal of any employees.

The Industrial Relations Officer called on
Mr. L. I. Ovadia and Mr. J. G. Lipsman, Director and
General Manager respectively, at Messrs. Sassoon & Co.,
at 4.30 p.m. the same day, with a view to soliciting
information regarding the management's attitude toward the
settlement of the dispute. They stated that the Company
had too many employees at present due to slackness in
business. The latter had declared a strike without reason,
and therefore the management had decided to take back only
those employees whose services were required, and on the
management's own conditions. After consideration, the
above named agreed to reduce to a minimum the number of
dismissals, to be as follows:

Cathay Hotel ......... 27
Metropole ............ 2
Cathay Mansions ...... 32
                     ---
                     61

In addition to the discharging allowance equivalent
to 15 days' salary, and rice allowance plus service charge
as granted, Mr. Ovadia agreed to grant a further month's
salary and rice allowance for those employees having com-
pleted between five years and 10 years' service; and a
further two months' salary and rice allowance for those
over 10 years. He also promised that there would be no
unreasonable dismissals in future, and the employees would
have the right to protest against this.

At 10 a.m. on September 3, representatives of the
employees again called in the Division office. They were
informed of the firm attitude of their management and also
of the concessions with regard to discharging allowance
together with the promise of no unreasonable dismissals
in future. They were not fully satisfied, still hoping to
reduce the number of dismissals, and also insisting on an
increase in discharging allowance for those whose services
totalled less than two years.

Messrs. Ovadia and Lipsman were informed of the
employees' request by the Industrial Relations Officer at
11 a.m., at Messrs. Sassoon & Co. Mr. Ovadia agreed to
give a fourth concession by granting a minimum discharging
allowance of one month's salary and rice allowance to those
who had worked for at least three months or more, but
refused to reconsider the number of dismissals.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

分署/
逮捕了在国泰饭店外纠察、阻止员工上班的18名罢工者。

9月2日下午2时，上述四家酒店的六名员工代表，即王仰谦（音译）、华孝根（音译）、胡星山（音译）、纪光平（音译）、陈益平（音译）和赵麦春（音译），前往劳工与社会处办公室递交请愿书，请求调解。他们表示员工并无其他要求，愿意无条件复工，且不辞退任何员工。

同日午后4时30分，劳资关系专员拜访了沙逊洋行的董事 L. I. Ovadia 先生和总经理 J. G. Lipsman 先生，旨在了解管理层对解决纠纷的态度。他们表示，由于生意清淡，公司目前员工过多。员工无故罢工，因此管理层决定仅按管理层自定条件收回所需之员工。经考虑，上述人士同意将解雇人数减至最低限度，具体如下：

国泰饭店 ......... 27
都城饭店 ............ 2
国泰公寓 ...... 32
                     ---
                     61

除已授予的相当于15天薪金的解雇津贴、米贴及服务费分成外，Ovadia 先生同意向服务年限满五年至十年的员工额外发放一个月薪金及米贴；向服务年限超过十年者额外发放两个月薪金及米贴。他还承诺今后不会有无理解雇行为，员工有权对此提出抗议。

9月3日上午10时，员工代表再次来到该处办公室。他们获悉了管理层的坚定立场，以及关于解雇津贴的让步和未来无理解雇的承诺。他们并不完全满意，仍希望减少解雇人数，并坚持增加服务年限不足两年者的解雇津贴。

上午11时，劳资关系专员在沙逊洋行将员工的请求告知了 Ovadia 先生和 Lipsman 先生。Ovadia 先生同意给予第四项让步，即向工作至少三个月或以上的员工发放最低一个月的薪金及米贴作为解雇津贴，但拒绝重新考虑解雇人数。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

The employees' representatives were informed of
the final reply of the management, and were persuaded
to take the above conditions. They asked that the matter
be referred to the whole body of employees for the latter's
consideration in the afternoon, at the San Ho Lodging House
(三和旅館) Edinburgh Road. After lengthy discussion,
the employees insisted that rice allowance be paid for the
period of the strike. The management at first flatly
refused, and finally agreed to pay a rice allowance of
seven days in order to reach a peaceful settlement. After
persuasion, the employees agreed to accept the above con-
ditions of the management.

At 7 p.m. the same day, the following conditions
of settlement were drawn up and signed by Mr. J. G. Lipsman,
representing the management:

(1) The management shall take back only
those employees whose services are
required.

(2) All the telephone operators, with the
exception of one Night telephone
operator, shall be replaced by girls
from the Shanghai Telephone Company.

(3) The management has authorized Mr.
Stahley, Manager of the Cathay Hotel,
Mr. Arregger, Manager of the Metropole
Hotel, Mr. Garreau, Manager of Cathay
Mansions and Mr. P. Bavard, Manager
of Kitchens of Cathay Hotels, Ltd., to
take back only those employees whose ser-
vices they require.

(4) The general manager is the sole person
who has the full right to transfer from
one department to another, or from one
Hotel to another, any Chinese employee
of the Company, and, upon his orders,
the Managers of the Hotels or Kitchens
have the right to effect such transfers.

The Management shall not tolerate any
discussion on this matter; his orders will
have to be complied with without any
argument.

(5) The general manager has the full au-
thority to dismiss any employee, with-
out previous notice.

It is understood however, that such
action on the part of the management
will be provoked only by misconduct,
failure to obey orders, bad execution
of work, or joining the Union.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

员工代表获悉管理层的最终答复，并被劝接受上述条件。他们要求将此事项提交全体员工，于当日下午在爱丁堡路三和旅馆进行审议。经过长时间讨论，员工坚持要求支付罢工期间的米贴。管理层起初断然拒绝，最后为了达成和平解决，同意支付七天米贴。经劝说，员工同意接受管理层的上述条件。

同日晚7时，拟定以下和解条件，并由代表管理层的 J. G. Lipsman 先生签署：

(1) 管理层仅收回所需之员工。

(2) 除一名夜间电话接线员外，所有电话接线员均由上海电话公司的女接线员替换。

(3) 管理层授权国泰饭店经理 Stahley 先生、都城饭店经理 Arregger 先生、国泰公寓经理 Garreau 先生以及国泰饭店有限公司厨房经理 P. Bavard 先生，仅收回其所需之员工。

(4) 总经理拥有全权将公司任何华籍员工从一个部门调至另一个部门，或从一家酒店调至另一家酒店；根据其命令，各酒店或厨房经理有权执行此类调动。

管理层不容忍对此事进行任何讨论；其命令必须无条件服从，不得有任何争辩。

(5) 总经理拥有全权无需预先通知即可解雇任何员工。

但需理解，管理层的此类行动仅由不当行为、不服从命令、工作执行不力或加入工会所引发。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

(6) In case notice is given due to the or-
ganization of the Hotels or for reason
of service, the employee dismissed is
granted the following indemnity:-

15 days salary and rice allowance
plus service charge average for
previous month, for every year
of service.

If the employee works over five (5)
years, up to ten (10) years, he will get
a further bonus of one (1) month's
salary and rice allowance.

If the employee works over ten (1)
years he will get two (2) months'
salary and rice allowance.

The minimum of one month's salary and
rice allowance will be given to those
who have worked for at least three months
or more.

(7) In case notice is given due to negli-
gence on the part of the employee in per-
forming his duties, or disobedience, bad
discipline, theft etc., the employee thus
dismissed is not entitled to any indem-
nity whatsoever.

(8) In case of death of any employee, the
family of the deceased is entitled to the
indemnity as granted in paragraph 1,
plus one hundred Shanghai dollars
(Sh$100.00) for funeral expenses.

(9) In case of illness or accident occurring
during the performance of duties, if
such illness or accident is certified by
a Doctor nominated by the Company or the
Lester Chinese Hospital, the employee is
entitled, providing his illness does not
exceed forty-five days (45), to his
salary, rice allowance and his share in
the service charges.

If his illness exceeds forty-five days,
he will be dismissed and he will be en-
titled to the indemnity granted in
paragraph No. 1, which indemnity will
start from the first day of his illness,
after deduction of the 45 days' salary
etc. already paid.

(10) Seven (7) days' Allowance - Rice Allow-
ance will be given to all Chinese em-
ployees who return to work tomorrow.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

(6) 若因酒店组织架构或服务原因发出通知，被解雇员工将获得以下赔偿金：

每服务一年，给予15天薪金及米贴，加上前一个月平均服务费分成。

若员工服务超过五（5）年但不超过十（10）年，将额外获得一（1）个月薪金及米贴作为奖金。

若员工服务超过十（10）年，将获得两（2）个月薪金及米贴。

向工作至少三个月或以上者发放最低一个月薪金及米贴。

(7) 若因员工履行职责时的疏忽、违抗命令、纪律涣散、盗窃等原因发出通知，被解雇员工无权获得任何赔偿金。

(8) 若任何员工死亡，其家属有权获得第1款规定的赔偿金，外加上海银元壹佰圆（Sh$100.00）作为丧葬费。

(9) 若在履行职责期间发生疾病或事故，且该疾病或事故经公司指定医生或莱斯德华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital）证明，员工有权在其病假不超过四十五（45）天的情况下，领取薪金、米贴及其应得的服务费分成。

若其病假超过四十五天，将被解雇，并有权获得第1款规定的赔偿金，该赔偿金将从其患病第一天起算，扣除已支付的45天薪金等款项。

(10) 七（7）天津贴——凡明日复工的所有华籍员工，将获得七天米贴。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

The Industrial Relations Officer accompanied by two repre-
sentatives of the management, namely Messrs. M. J. Devicha
and Chu Chia Loong (朱家龍 ), proceeded again to the
San Ho Lodging House, Edinburgh Road, to meet the employees'
representatives for their final signature. However, they
were still not satisfied with Condition 7, regarding the
dismissal of employees, and refused to resume work.
After a written note was signed by the management's repre-
sentatives and the mediator guaranteeing that Messrs. L.
Ovadia and J. G. Lipsman would not unreasonably dismiss
any employee, the employees were satisfied and all agreed
to resume work the next morning. The Industrial Relations
Officer left the premises at 8 p.m.

The same evening, five employees arrested by
the French police, and 18 employees arrested by the Central
Police Station, S.M.P., were released at the request of
the management.

The Chinese employees of the above hotels resumed
work this morning, September 4, 1941. The dismissed
employees and those who have resigned will be paid off by
the management on September 5.

The Hamilton House will be converted into offices
from September 15, 1941, and the 40 employees with the
exception of a few boys to be transferred to the Metropole
Hotel, will also be paid off according to the agreed upon
discharging allowance.

The dispute, therefore, is settled.

Smith
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

劳资关系专员在管理层两名代表，即 M. J. Devicha 先生和朱家龍先生的陪同下，再次前往爱丁堡路三和旅社，与雇员代表会面以签署最终协议。然而，他们对关于解雇雇员的第7条条件仍不满意，并拒绝复工。在管理层代表和调解人签署了一份书面便条，保证 L. Ovadia 先生和 J. G. Lipsman 先生不会无理解雇任何雇员后，雇员们表示满意，并均同意于次日上午复工。劳资关系专员于晚上8时离开现场。

同日晚，应管理层要求，被法国警察逮捕的五名雇员和被上海公共租界工部局中央捕房逮捕的18名雇员获释。

上述旅馆的中国雇员已于今晨，即1941年9月4日复工。被解雇的雇员及已辞职者将由管理层于9月5日结清薪资。

汉密尔顿公寓将于1941年9月15日起改为办公用途，除少数勤杂工将调往大都会酒店外，其余40名雇员也将按照商定的遣散费标准予以结算。

至此，纠纷已解决。

Smith
